public_definitions: The goal is to review the cooling water temperature dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
The comparison scope is the full-period cooling water temperature change from 2005 to 2014.
The supplied rules are to use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period cooling water temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
